create_C51_agent: create a C51 agent instance with a network, optimizer, replay buffer, and epsilon schedule
run_C51_step: run a C51 agent step to select an action given a dm_env timestep and optionally learn
review_C51_loss_fn: review the C51 agent loss function that computes categorical Q-learning loss over a batch of transitions
test_C51_update: test the C51 agent update method that computes gradients and applies optimizer updates via JAX JIT
summarize_C51_select_action: summarize the C51 agent epsilon-greedy action selection policy using the online network Q-values
